model: deepseek-flash, thinking high, max_tokens 65536, request read timeout 300 s
budget: USD 6 on the uncached peak-rate ledger of decisive.jsonl; every request without usage (timeout/HTTP error) charged 0.0786 live; stop at cap
infra_rule: timeouts / HTTP errors / no usage are excluded from denominators and rerun once; still-failing runs are listed separately
tests: Wilson 95% intervals per cell; two-sided Fisher exact test for pre-registered contrasts; alpha 0.05; no other contrasts are called conclusions

exp1.question: Is the counter_hidden failure caused by hidden laws alone, by a wrong textbook prior, or by low identifiability of quantities only visible through total harvest?

cells.counter_given: NEW 16 fresh instances (A/counter/0.1 x8, 0.001 x8); the 6 phase-1 runs reported separately
cells.text_hidden: NEW 16 fresh instances, real physics, laws removed from spec
cells.counter_hidden_obs: NEW 16 fresh instances, counterfactual, laws removed, feedback adds load_match_0to1 and source_impedance_kohm (as directly as resonance_Hz)

hypotheses.H1a_prior: text_hidden >> counter_hidden (Fisher p<0.05) and text_hidden >= 12/16: hiding laws hurts mainly when the textbook prior is wrong
hypotheses.H1b_laws_only: text_hidden <= 6/16 and not different from counter_hidden: hiding laws is enough
hypotheses.H1c_identifiability: counter_hidden_obs >> counter_hidden (Fisher p<0.05): exposing the electrical matching quantity rescues the counterfactual hidden case
hypotheses.H1d_given: counter_given >= 13/16: given laws the counterfactual world is not hard

exp1.interaction: difference in differences of pass rates (text_given-text_hidden) - (counter_given-counter_hidden), reported with both Fisher contrasts; called an interaction only if H1a and H1d both hold

exp2.question: Are INFEASIBLE verdicts calibrated on difficulty-matched pairs, and do a branch-optimize gate or a sound global bound fix false INFEASIBLE / premature branch abandonment (T4b/C4 defect)?
exp2.tasks: 8 matched pairs: same env (fresh source_Hz, bump_g), stress task needing shunt S, default shunt_thr_V=2 below the background open voltage at resonance (T4b-like: enabling S at default wastes 80% harvest); feasible twin optimum margin +0.03 with stored witness, infeasible twin -0.03 (only sensor load differs). Infeasibility certified by a sound interval branch-and-bound bound on min(energy,stress) slack for all 16 module combinations.

arms.branch: after enabling a module the agent may not disable it or declare INFEASIBLE before optimize_branch(module) (grid over the module's own parameter at the current design; not an evaluation)
arms.bound: global_bound() returns the sound per-combination upper bounds; INFEASIBLE accepted only if all are < 0, else UNSURE

exp2.n: 16 tasks x 3 arms = 48 runs, 6 evaluations each; priority order base, branch, bound pairs 0-3, then Exp 3, then bound pairs 4-7
metrics: structure retention: S installed at end
enabled-then-abandoned-after-one-default-point rate (S turned on with shunt_thr_V unchanged, off at the next evaluation)

hypotheses.H2a_miscalibration: base: >=2 false INFEASIBLE on the 8 feasible twins, and AUC < 0.8
hypotheses.H2b_branch_gate: branch pass rate on feasible > base (Fisher p<0.05) or false INFEASIBLE reduced to 0 with abandonment rate lower
hypotheses.H2c_bound: bound arm has 0 false INFEASIBLE (guaranteed by design) and its pass rate on feasible is reported vs base

exp2.deviation_note: requested random feasible volume 1e-3..1e-2 is checked and reported; if unreachable in this world it is documented, not forced

cells.H/prims/stress: existing 8 confirm instances; rerun the 3 infra ones

hypotheses.H3b: B py >= 6/8 and nopy <= 2/8 and Fisher p<0.05

conclusion_rule: a claim is a conclusion only if its pre-registered criterion holds on fresh instances; otherwise it is reported as a hint

addendum_round2.budget: new USD 5 (separate from round 1's 5.92), conservative uncached peak-rate ledger, split into two independent caps that sum to 5: Exp 3 CAP=1.6 in decisive2_exp3.jsonl, Exp 2 CAP=3.4 in decisive2_exp2.jsonl (calibration gate included); streaming, read timeout 300 s, WORKERS=6, no run killed mid-flight; Exp 3 and Exp 2 run in parallel
addendum_round2.infra_rule: unchanged: infra failures excluded and rerun once if budget allows; BUDGET_STOP excluded

cells.H/prims/stress: the 8 confirm instances; run the 3 that were infra (#1,#5,#7) so n=8 valid

hypotheses.H3a: H/prims/stress pass rate < H/prims/wake (8/8), Fisher two-sided p<0.05, n=8
hypotheses.H3b: B py >= 80% (>=7/8 when n=8) and nopy <= 20% (<=1/8), plus Fisher p<0.05 (stricter than round-1 6/8, 2/8 per user request)

exp2_redo_G3.design: identical 8 matched pairs, envs, witnesses, sound bounds and arms as G2; ONLY change: module S semantics hidden: variable renamed S_setting_V ('setting of module S, V'), module described as 'piezo protection circuit with one setting'; no threshold meaning, no direction, no 80% harvest-loss statement. Default S_setting_V=2 is below the background open voltage (~3.3-3.5 V): enabling S at default fixes stress but drops energy slack from +0.03 to about -0.8 and cold_start to about -60 (clearly harmful); passing requires S on and setting above open_V. Random feasible volume reported as in round 1 (0..5e-7).
exp2_redo_G3.calibration_gate: base arm on G3 pairs p0,p1 feasible first; proceed if at least one shows S enabled then abandoned, or fails; if both pass trivially, harden once (also hide open_V from outputs) and document
exp2_redo_G3.n: 3 arms x 16 tasks; if budget short keep base and branch at 16, bound reduced to pairs 0-3 (8 tasks), documented
exp2_redo_G3.metrics: as G2: feasible pass rate, INFEASIBLE precision/recall, AUC, false INFEASIBLE, enabled-then-abandoned-after-default-point rate, structure retention (S at end); Wilson 95%, Fisher

hypotheses.H2a': G3 base: >=2 false INFEASIBLE on 8 feasible OR AUC<0.8 (miscalibration appears once the branch is opaque)
hypotheses.H2t_trap: G3 base abandon-after-default rate > G2 base (0/25 S-trajectories in round 1), reported descriptively with Fisher on per-run abandon counts
hypotheses.H2b': G3 branch feasible pass rate > G3 base (Fisher p<0.05), or false INFEASIBLE reduced to 0 with lower abandonment
hypotheses.H2c': G3 bound arm: 0 false INFEASIBLE; pass rate vs base reported
hypotheses.H2s_semantics: G3 base feasible pass < G2 base 8/8 (Fisher p<0.05): hiding parameter semantics alone creates the failure
